left.title: New Video Complicates Uproar Over Incident Between Student And Native American Man
left.body: The student in the video said he’s received death threats after the confrontation, and attempted to clarify that he was trying to help defuse the situation.
left.roundup: A video showing a Kentucky student confronting a Native American man draws controversy, as a fuller video complicates the uproar.

center.title: Fuller video casts new light on Covington Catholic students' encounter with Native American elder
center.body: The furor over the behavior of a group of Catholic school students from Kentucky toward a Native American elder during weekend protests in Washington, D.C., took a turn Sunday with the emergence of a new video.
center.roundup: A video showing a Kentucky student confronting a Native American man draws controversy, as a fuller video complicates the uproar.

right.title: Kentucky student seen in viral confrontation with Native American speaks out
right.body: The Kentucky high school student seen in a viral video standing-face-to-face with a Native American protester at a Washington rally spoke out for the first time Sunday evening, claiming in a statement that he and his classmates were taunted by a group of African-American protesters and saying that he and his family had received death threats.
right.roundup: A video showing a Kentucky student confronting a Native American man draws controversy, as a fuller video complicates the uproar.
